title: BECE English Studies: Grammar & Structure - English Studies - Parts of Speech - Conjunctions
subject: English Studies

questions.q:
Select the correct subordinating conjunction to join the clauses:
"We will not go for the picnic _____ it stops raining."
questions.explain: 'Unless' is a subordinating conjunction of condition that means 'except if'. The sentence means they won't go for the picnic if it doesn't stop raining.
questions.subject: English Studies

questions.q:
Choose the correct subordinating conjunction to complete the sentence:
"Scarcely had she finished reading the book _____ the electricity went off."
questions.explain: The correlative conjunction pair is 'scarcely... when' (or 'hardly... when'). 'Than' is used with 'no sooner'.
questions.subject: English Studies

questions.q:
Select the appropriate subordinating conjunction to introduce contrast:
"_____ he was completely exhausted, he stayed up to finish the project."
questions.explain: 'Although' introduces a subordinate clause of contrast or concession, indicating that the action occurred in spite of his exhaustion.
questions.subject: English Studies

questions.q:
Choose the correct conjunction to complete the sentence:
"You can choose to drink _____ tea or coffee."
questions.explain: The correlative conjunction pair 'either...or' is used to present a choice between two alternatives. 'Neither' pairs with 'nor', and 'both' pairs with 'and'.
